options: A childhood that develops slowly and is not rushed
A child who is slow to learn
questions.explain: Do not rush early education; even in the Prophet's time children were not pushed to write and memorise early.

questions.q: Who was Shaymaa to the Prophet SAW and how did he recognise her after the conquest of Makkah?
options: His foster sister, by the bite mark on her back
His wet nurse, by her voice
questions.explain: Shaymaa was captured after the conquest of Makkah and recognised by the bite mark on her back.

questions.q: At what age was Anas bin Malik sent by his mother to serve the Prophet SAW?
questions.explain: Anas served ten years without ever being scolded harshly.

questions.q: How much longer did Halimah plead to keep him in the village?
questions.explain: Halimah saw a child who brought blessing and was mature.

questions.q: What effect does housework have according to the long-term research the ustaz mentioned?
options: Children who do chores are more successful and stable as adults

questions.q: What do children learn through playing with friends?
options: Waiting their turn, reading body language and responding
questions.explain: Play builds emotional and social intelligence.

questions.q: Parents must act as referee in every quarrel between children.
questions.explain: False. Let children settle conflicts themselves so they learn to apologise.

questions.q: Toys that over-direct play limit a child's imagination.
questions.explain: True. Give children room to play freely.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Halimah pleads for two more years
The Prophet SAW plays in Banu Sa'd

questions.explain: He played in the village, Halimah pleaded, she sent him home, and he began a new life in Makkah.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: Shielding a child so much they cannot take risks

questions.explain: Chutzpah is courage, free play is open play, overprotective means shielding too much, and conflict resolution is the skill of settling disputes.

questions.q: Your child wants to try something a little risky but safe. What does the ustaz advise?
options: Give room to take risks so the child becomes independent and confident
questions.explain: Over-protecting causes anxiety and loss of confidence.
